opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: covers the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low-income households who are ineligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government; ordinarily resident in Scotland with at least two years of secondary schooling/college in Scotland or a substantial recent connection to Scotland; entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK, have Limited Leave to Remain, or be an asylum seeker; enrolled on an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish institution.
opportunities.summary: Grants covering tuition fees (up to £1,820/year) for students from low-income households who are ineligible for government tuition fee support, studying an undergraduate degree at an eligible Scottish higher education institution.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie-Morgan Scholarship

amount.raw: Full tuition fees for the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants plus an additional living-cost bursary of £1,200

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scottish-domiciled students from low-income households; ordinarily resident in Scotland; accepted onto the MSc Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants (full-time or part-time); entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK; not already holding a postgraduate degree.
opportunities.summary: Scholarship, in partnership with the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh, covering full tuition fees and a £1,200 living-cost bursary for the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants (delivered by RBGE and the University of Edinburgh), to widen participation in postgraduate plant science and botany study.
